title: Priorities for cancer research in low- and middle-income countries: a global perspective

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Priorities for cancer research in low- and middle-income countries: a global perspective》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Cancer research currently is heavily skewed toward high-income countries (HICs), with little research conducted in, and relevant to, the problems of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

evidence.text: Cancer research currently is heavily skewed toward high-income countries (HICs), with little research conducted in, and relevant to, the problems of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Priorities for cancer research in low- and middle-income countries: a global perspective》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We identified five top priorities in cancer research in LMICs based on current and projected needs: reducing the burden of patients with advanced disease; improving access and affordability, and outcomes of cancer treatment; value-based care and health economics; quality improvement and implementation research; and leveraging technology to improve cancer control.
